column1: # Blind: fresh-context referee, package-only, no project context. Package built fresh at 61a79f0
# and the artifact verified byte-identical to main before the pass.
# Package: ARTIFACT (kappa-3-r2) + Contract + cards S1/S2 + deps (kappa-1-r3, kappa-2-r2)
# The predecessor was supplied ONLY so the revision note's byte-identity claims could be checked
# mechanically; the referee was told not to treat its mathematics as authoritative. The pass-1
# findings file was deliberately EXCLUDED, and the package build aborts if any findings, triage
# or tally file appears in it, so that pass 1's conclusions could not leak.
# Severity as assigned by this pass. All four findings upheld without a separate triage pass;
# recorded as a deviation in the findings file.
# One class-(E) entry is charged to the reviewer's packaging, not to the artifact: the prompt
# named the cards/ directory without naming its files and the agent type had no directory
# listing, so two §4 card quotations went unchecked. Not counted as a defect below.
# No earlier tally carries over: each was recorded against different content.
